lines.text: Many learners say: Open the light.
Turn on! Please turn on the light.

native.tip: 불을 켤 때는 open이 아니라 turn on! “Turn on the light”예요.
native.caption: “Open the light”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 전등이나 TV를 켤 때는 open이 아니라 turn on을 써요. “Turn on the light”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “turn on”. 불 켜기는 turn on! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: To switch on a light, say turn on, not open.
en.caption: Do you say “Open the light”? 😅 Open is for doors. For lights and TVs, use “turn on”. “Turn on the light” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
